messages:
sre_emily: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx spike in eu-west API gateway, ~12% error rate over last 3m, mostly 502/504. Customers hitting embedding and streaming endpoints.
incident-bot: Pager acknowledged. Runbook: https://intranet/runbooks/gateway-5xx. On-call: @oncall_kai.
oncall_kai: I'm on it, joining now. Any recent deploys or config changes?
sre_emily: We had a header-based routing rollout ~22m ago (canary 10%). Traffic split rule 'header-split' was applied to eu-west. Logs show a lot of upstream reset/timeout: `recv ECONNRESET` and `upstream timed out (110)` from provider pool.
eng_jordan: That header routing change is mine — investigating. If it's selector-related we can scoped-rollback the rule for eu-west only.
eng_jordan: Running command to disable rule in eu-west: `redwoodctl route set header-split --region eu-west --enabled=false` — applying now.
eng_jordan: Applied. Scaling fallback routes +1 replica to drain queues: `k scale deploy apigw-fallback -n gateway --replicas=3`.
oncall_kai: Watching metrics... error rate dropped from 12% -> 3.2% in last 45s. Latency also trending down.
product_anya: Customer impact: seeing multiple errors from PLG onboarding flows, some CS tickets. Recommend preparing a succinct status page entry.
sre_emily: Agreed — draft: "Partial outage impacting API requests in EU-WEST. We applied a rollback to a routing change; traffic is recovering. Ongoing investigation." Approve?
product_anya: LGTM, will post in 5.
eng_jordan: Also reverted a sidecar proxy config tweak that was gated to the same canary group. Patch: `git revert --no-commit proxy/sidecar/2026-03-15-ttl-change` then `kubectl apply -f proxy/sidecar/`.
oncall_kai: Error rate now ~0.7% and falling. Most requests show 200. No new SLO alerts.
incident-bot: Incident state: mitigation in progress -> partial mitigation confirmed. Notifying downstream teams.
sre_emily: Collecting traces and headers for suspect requests — will attach to postmortem. Hypothesis: routing TTL + backend pool rebalancing caused transient mismatches and connection resets under burst.
eng_jordan: I will gather config diffs and deploy timeline. Will run a canary with longer TTL locally later.
product_anya: Status page updated: "Partial degradation in EU-WEST affecting some API traffic. Mitigation applied and traffic recovering. More updates to follow."
oncall_kai: Marking incident mitigated, handing off to eng_jordan for RCA and postmortem. I'm back to normal rotation.
sre_emily: Created incident ticket PD-3125 and scheduled 1hr follow-up RCA meeting tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Will close channel after postmortem link added. :white_check_mark:
eng_jordan: Noted — will include traces, routing rule config, and rollout steps in the postmortem. Thanks for quick ops.
product_anya: Thanks team. Keeping CS notified. :thumbsup:
